dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000szxz](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000szxz) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on May 24 2026 13km NE of Cortes. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 9.3137 longitude 126.3038. It impacted 197369 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
